description: ds55 — BAR tasks by project, filter on dept (cross-dim via tasks)

result.sql_normalized: SELECT dataset_table_183.name AS dataset_table_183_name, COUNT(*) AS dataset_table_182_task_count FROM (SELECT * FROM `base-testlab-01.base_wework.test_task`) AS dataset_table_182 LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM `base-testlab-01.base_wework.test_project`) AS dataset_table_183 ON dataset_table_182.project_id = dataset_table_183.id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT * FROM `base-testlab-01.base_wework.test_project`) AS dataset_table_183 INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM `base-testlab-01.base_wework.test_dept`) AS dataset_table_184 ON dataset_table_183.dept_id = dataset_table_184.id WHERE dataset_table_182.project_id = dataset_table_183.id AND dataset_table_184.name IN ('Engineering')) GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10000000
